title: [Resource] Open-source gaming dataset for LLM Fine-Tuning & RAG (Cyberpunk, GTA V/FiveM, Minecraft, Roblox)
author: Sharp_Magazine7734
selftext:
Released v4.0.0 of the Gaming AI Corpus. It contains clean, structured text datasets in .jsonl and .txt formats built for fine-tuning Large Language Models and building RAG systems for gaming applications.

Covered Datasets:

* Cyberpunk 2077: Lore, mechanics, Cyberware specs, dialogue structures, and RPG rules.
* GTA V & FiveM: Game mechanics, LUA scripting, native functions, and server framework documentation (QBCore/ESX).
* Minecraft: 70,000+ cleaned lines of wiki guides, crafting recipes, Skript/Plugin configurations, and mechanics.
* Roblox: Luau scripting, Roblox Studio API structures, GUI logic, and engine mechanics.

Primary Use Cases:

* Fine-tuning base LLMs (Llama 3, Mistral, Gemma) via QLoRA/Unsloth.
* Building RAG vector databases for specialized gaming knowledge bases.
* Training custom AI game masters or NPC dialogue agents.
